description: Customer users look up a vendor's compliance status, view stored certificates and licenses, and approve or hold vendors before work starts on a site
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers check status before letting subcontractors on site each morning; the 99.5% monthly uptime target allows about 3.6 hours of downtime in a 30-day month; the 2 anchor customers earn service credits; a full day down would put the anchor renewal at risk
manual_workaround: Customers use their last weekly compliance export (CSV) and phone the Customer Success Manager for urgent checks
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; internet service at staff home offices
dependent_people_or_facilities: CTO; Senior Software Engineer; Customer Success Manager

description: Vendors upload certificates, W-9s, and licenses through upload links or email intake; the AI extraction feature fills in fields; customer reviewers confirm the result
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An uploaded document lost after the vendor sent it must be requested again, which can take days; losing tax forms or certificates is a loss of customer data under the DPA; extraction can fall back to manual entry
manual_workaround: Upload links queue files in object storage; if the AI model provider is down, documents go to the manual review queue and the Customer Success Manager keys in fields for urgent vendors
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; AI model provider; email delivery service

description: Nightly jobs flag documents that expire within 30 days and email upload links to vendors and alerts to customer users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reminders that run a day late still reach vendors before most expiry dates; jobs can be re-run from the database state
manual_workaround: Re-run the nightly job after recovery; the Customer Success Manager emails the customers' compliance coordinators a list of documents expiring within 7 days

description: Support tickets, onboarding of new customers and their vendor lists, configuration of compliance requirements per customer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers expect same-day replies; onboarding dates are scheduled weeks ahead and can move a day or two
manual_workaround: Use the shared support mailbox in the productivity suite and the Customer Success Manager's phone; post updates on the status page
dependent_third_parties: Support desk SaaS; productivity suite vendor; MSP

description: Code review, automated builds, and deployments of fixes and features
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to ship urgent fixes during an incident; source code also exists in each engineer's local clone
manual_workaround: Build and deploy from a clean company laptop with a documented manual procedure (to be written with the contingency plan)

description: Customers generate monthly vendor compliance reports for property owners, insurers, and auditors, and weekly CSV exports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most reports are monthly; a delay of up to 3 days is tolerable if customers are told
manual_workaround: Customer Success Manager runs reports for customers once the platform is back; customers reuse the prior month's report

description: Demos, proposals, and answers to customer and prospect security questionnaires
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Sales cycles run for weeks; a week's pause loses no deal on its own
manual_workaround: Use personal phones and a demo recording; reply to questionnaires after recovery with CTO approval

description: Customer invoicing through the payment processor, payroll through an outside payroll service, contracts, insurance, and HR files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices run monthly and payroll biweekly; a cash reserve covers about 60 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; invoices are sent late from the payment processor's portal
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; payroll service; productivity suite vendor; MSP
